about.title: About the Aquapolis set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Aquapolis is a e-Card expansion released on 15 January 2003. It has 186 cards: 151 in the main set and 3 secret rares and 32 Holo Rares cards. There are also 148 reverse holos.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 151 main set cards), the Master set (299 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 334 cards, adding the 3 secret rares and 32 Holo Rares cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
